subject: MAP: compressed close — slippage triage and credit stopgap
messages:
From: Faye Olson <faye.olson@fathomhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP risk — procurement hold threatens 11/10 close

Marissa —

Quick note from procurement: our CFO pushed the budget approval and procurement wants formal SOC 2 evidence plus the data retention SLA clarified before the legal signoff. That pushes our internal acceptance window out and threatens the 11/10 go-live we discussed.

Top blockers:
- SOC 2 evidence (procurement requested a specific snapshot and the third-party attestation PDF)
- Clarification on retention policy for embeddings (legal wants a short bullet in SOW)
- DocuSign needing the final SOW redlines by end of week or they will queue vendor review for two weeks

We like Redwood and want to keep the momentum, but procurement is explicit about not moving forward without the above. Can you propose a short-term MAP update or credit to bridge their concern?

I attached procurement_requirements.pdf from their team.

—Faye
Faye Olson
Head of Strategic Ops, Fathom Health
faye.olson@fathomhealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Faye Olson <faye.olson@fathomhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP risk — procurement hold threatens 11/10 close

Faye — thanks for the clarity and the PDF. We can move quickly. Proposal below is a narrowly scoped MAP update to keep your go-live window intact or provide a clear rebaseline with mitigation paths.

Immediate proposal (MAP v2, attached):
1) Short rebaseline: move close target from 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-24 if procurement requires longer legal review.
2) Bridge offer: a one-time service credit equal to 10% of the first quarter invoice if final SOW cannot be executed by 11/10 and you accept the 11/24 fallback.
3) Evidence delivery: Redwood will provide a SOC2 evidence snapshot and a one-page retention addendum by 2026-11-01 EOD.
4) Acceptance carve-out: technical acceptance tests will be staged — we will commit an acceptance matrix and runbook (see acceptance_matrix.csv) and agree to a two-step signoff to accelerate parallel testing.

Ben — can you confirm the runbook ETA and whether the acceptance matrix suffices for your team to sign off on the staged tests?
Jordan — procurement/finance, can we commit to the SOC2 snapshot and the SOW retention bullet for the DocuSign flow? If we can get verbal OK by 2026-11-01 EOD, we will lock the bridge credit and evidence delivery.

I attached proposed_MAP_v2.xlsx and the acceptance_matrix.csv reference. Will follow up with a short executive escalation note if we hit delays.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Faye Olson <faye.olson@fathomhealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP risk — procurement hold threatens 11/10 close

Marissa / Faye —

Technical confirmation: we can produce the acceptance runbook and a condensed test harness that runs the core evals in parallel with procurement's legal review. Key notes:
- Runbook ETA: 2026-10-31 14:00 PT (deliverable: acceptance_matrix.csv expanded to pass/fail scripts)
- SOC2 snapshot: ops will produce the control mapping document and the auditor statement export by 2026-11-01
- Short-term QA: we'll provide 2x accelerated test windows (11/02–11/04) where Fathom can run smoke + performance tests against a fenced environment.

If procurement wants a live session, I can host a 30-min technical walkthrough for your security reviewer on 11/02.

Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Faye Olson <faye.olson@fathomhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-31T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP risk — procurement hold threatens 11/10 close

Marissa / Team / Faye —

Finance/procurement note: I spoke with our contracts & billing teams. We can approve the one-time 10% goodwill credit (applied to the first invoice) contingent on getting the final SOW redlines into DocuSign by 2026-11-01 COB and confirmation that Fathom will accept the staged acceptance plan.

I've filed a quick HubSpot note and linked the DocuSign draft here: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4287 — DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/FA-4287-signature.

If Fathom cannot hit the 11/01 sign-off, we should default to the rebaseline date 2026-11-24 and proceed with the bridge credit only if the SOW is executed by that date.

Jordan Blake
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Faye Olson <faye.olson@fathomhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:38:00-07:00
Subject: Final: MAP update and contingency — Fathom Health (DEAL-4287)

Faye — thanks for the call earlier. Per our commitments below, this is the agreed MAP update and escalation path:

Agreed items (MAP_final.pdf attached):
- Primary: target close moved to 2026-11-24 (soft-lock rebaseline) unless DocuSign redlines complete by 2026-11-01 COB, in which case the original 2026-11-10 target stands.
- Bridge: one-time 10% credit applied to Q1 invoice if SOW can’t be executed by 11/10 and Fathom accepts 11/24 fallback.
- Evidence: SOC2 snapshot and one-page retention addendum to be delivered by Redwood on 2026-11-01 (delivered).
- Acceptance: Ben’s team will provide the expanded acceptance_matrix.csv and two accelerated smoke windows 11/02–11/04.
- Escalation: If procurement queues a second review cycle, Redwood will escalate to our VP of Sales and provide weekly cadence notes until signoff.

Next steps (owners & deadlines):
- Fathom: finalize SOW redlines in DocuSign — owner: procurement@fathomhealth.com — deadline: 2026-11-01 COB
- Redwood (Jordan): confirm credit authorization and update billing schedule — deadline: 2026-11-02 EOD
- Redwood (Ben): deliver expanded acceptance matrix and schedule walkthrough — ETA: 2026-10-31 delivered; walkthrough: 2026-11-02

If anything slips after 11/02, Marissa will send an exec escalation summary to accelerate approvals.

Thanks — we’ll keep this tight.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: MAP_final.pdf
